newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Bottling says H1 pretax down 7.2pct.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Bottling says H1 pretax down 7.2pct.

text.p: Greece's Hellenic Bottling (3E) said its first-half pretax profits after minorities amounted to 13.7 billion drachmas, down 7.2 percent after allowing for capital gains in the same period in 1995.

"The decline in profits is mainly attributed to the currency devaluation in Eastern European countries, Bulgaria in particular," it said in a statement. "This fact will not affect the investment plans of the group in these countries."
Consolidated sales rose four percent year-on-year to 76 billion drachmas in the first six months of 1996, it said.
The profit and loss account and the balance sheet have been prepared in accordance with the International Standard for Reporting in hyperinflation economies.
